input: Lack of capability or robustness is a not a risk associated with An automated content moderation system is designed to identify and flag potentially harmful posts, which are then reviewed and filtered to prevent the spread of misinformation. The system aims to prioritize high-quality content and reduce the visibility of low-quality or offensive posts. It uses machine learning algorithms to continuously improve its ability to detect and rank content accurately.
